from_notes: International Women's Day is observed every year on 8 March to celebrate women's achievements and push for gender equality; the UN recognised it in 1977. 8 July, 8 December and 8 October are not linked to it.

from_notes: National Panchayati Raj Day is observed on 24 April, the day the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 came into force (24 April 1993); PAI 2.0 was released on 24 April 2026. 2 October is Gandhi Jayanti, not Panchayati Raj Day.

from_notes: Bohag (Rongali) Bihu, in mid-April, marks the Assamese New Year and the arrival of spring. Magh (Bhogali) Bihu is the January harvest feast; Poila Boishakh is the Bengali New Year and Baisakhi is celebrated in Punjab.

x: Jagar is a night ritual of the Garhwal and Kumaon hills of Uttarakhand in which local deities and ancestral spirits are invoked through sung ballads and drums. It is not a form of worship of Madhya Pradesh, Haryana or Assam.
source: web: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jagar_(ritual) (fetched; cites E-Uttarakhand 'Folk Songs and Dances of Uttarakhand')
